paragraphs.text: Patients in hospital sleep badly: lights, alarms and night checks wake them again and again. One study found that the average patient was disturbed eleven times a night.
paragraphs.label: A

paragraphs.text: Several hospitals now group night checks together, so that a patient is woken once rather than three times. Staff also carry pagers that vibrate instead of ringing.
paragraphs.label: B

paragraphs.text: Sleep matters for recovery. Patients who sleep well leave hospital sooner on average, and confusion after operations is less common among them.
paragraphs.label: C

paragraphs.text: Not every ward can be quiet. In intensive care, monitors must sound, and nurses say that a completely dark room makes it harder to notice a change in a patient’s colour.
paragraphs.label: D

items.quote: Patients who sleep well leave hospital sooner on average
items.prompt: a benefit of good sleep for treatment

explanation.en: Better sleepers go home sooner — the benefit is in paragraph C.
explanation.kk: Жақсы ұйықтағандар ертерек шығады — емдеуге пайдасы, C абзацы.
explanation.ru: Спящие лучше выписываются раньше — польза для лечения, абзац C.

items.quote: In intensive care, monitors must sound
items.prompt: a reason why silence is not always possible

explanation.en: In intensive care monitors must sound — paragraph D.
explanation.kk: Реанимацияда аспаптар дыбыс шығаруға тиіс — D абзацы.
explanation.ru: В реанимации приборы обязаны звучать — абзац D.

items.quote: the average patient was disturbed eleven times a night
items.prompt: a measurement of how often sleep is interrupted

explanation.en: “disturbed eleven times a night” is the measurement — paragraph A.
explanation.kk: «disturbed eleven times a night» — өлшеу деген осы, A абзацы.
explanation.ru: «disturbed eleven times a night» — это и есть измерение, абзац A.

items.quote: group night checks together, so that a patient is woken once rather than three times
items.prompt: a change that reduces the number of times a patient is woken

explanation.en: Checks are grouped so the patient is woken less often — paragraph B.
explanation.kk: Тексерулер біріктірілген — сирек оятады, B абзацы.
explanation.ru: Проверки объединили — будят реже, абзац B.
